seo.title: AFL Decorating – Painters & Decorators in Harrow, London
seo.description: Andrew Farkas Limited: quality painting and decorating since 1992, covering London and the Home Counties. Interior and exterior decorating, wallpapering, plastering and more.

hero.lead: A client centred business, fully insured, focused on value for money while keeping the highest standards. We can manage your project from start to finish.

reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Andrew Farkas and his team worked very efficiently. They carried out external painting and repaired garage doors and a gate. The work was carried out as agreed and according to budget. Andrew and his team were helpful, reliable and kept me fully informed. I am very pleased with the result and would use them again. Highly recommended.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Detailed quote (which was stuck to), good communications throughout, excellent work and thorough cleaning up afterwards. We had the dining room repaired and decorated - strong recommendation from me.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: I recently received a quote for the work required. The work commenced at the arranged time and date and was completed in time to my satisfaction. The painter/decorator was more than helpful and went the 'extra mile' to do all that I requested. …
